label: Freshman Year
description: First year of the Early College High School program. Students attend ECHS-only classes in a dedicated wing of Timberview High School and have full access to Timberview's clubs and activities.

label: Sophomore Year
description: Second year at the Timberview ECHS wing. TCC dual-credit coursework begins this year, starting the path toward an Associate degree alongside the diploma.

label: Junior Year
description: Students now attend classes primarily at the Tarrant County College Southeast Campus, blended with TCC's regular college students. MISD teachers deliver required state courses on the TCC campus.

label: Senior Year
description: Final year at TCC Southeast Campus, working toward Associate of Arts / Associate of Science degree completion alongside the high school diploma.
